title: Trump threatens Oman, Iran war in stalemate as 60-day talks window ends
description: The 60-day deadline for the U.S. and Iran to negotiate a peace deal and reopen the Strait of Hormuz expired, with no agreement in sight.

title: It’s Crunchtime Again for Canada to Avoid New U.S. Tariffs
description: Canada is seeking a deal to dodge further economic pain at the hands of the Trump administration on midnight Tuesday. But at what cost?

title: LSU HC Lane Kiffin Believes Money Motivates His Players
description: LSU HC Lane Kiffin argued that money can motivate his players to work harder than athletes who were on scholarship.

title: Liberty getting dominated by Sky rookie only puts spotlight on potential Achilles heel
description: Sydney Taylor and the 13-win Sky have given the championship-hopeful Liberty more trouble than they should have this season.
